chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Sahl ibn Ziyad jointly, from Ibn Mahbub, from Jamil ibn Salih, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I heard him saying: 'Verily the one who struggles with the Quran and memorizes it with difficulty and with poor memory — for him are two rewards.'

key_terms.أَجْرَانِ: Two rewards (dual form) — one for the act itself and one for the difficulty endured
key_terms.قِلَّة حِفْظ: Weakness of memory, scarce retention — emphasizing that natural inability does not diminish spiritual merit
key_terms.مَشَقَّة: Hardship, difficulty, exertion — the very effort that doubles the divine reward
key_terms.يُعَالِجُ: To struggle with, toil over, engage persistently with a difficult task — here referring to repeated effort in reciting the Quran

ai.seo_question: Does a person who struggles to memorize the Quran receive a greater reward in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that a believer who finds Quran recitation and memorization difficult yet perseveres earns a double reward. This teaching was addressed to early Muslims in Kufa and Basra who revered Quran memorization as the highest devotional act; by affirming double reward for those who struggle, the Imam encouraged those who lacked natural aptitude and removed the stigma of difficulty.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Salih, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘
The one who addresses the Quran and memorises it with difficulty from him, and has scarce memorisation, for him would be two Recompenses (double)’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Sahl ibn Ziyad all from ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘
Those who face difficulty memorizing the Holy Quran due to lesser ability of memorization will be rewarded twofold.’”
